name: zeffect_anim_find_entry_by_name
description: zEffectAnim::FindEntryByName returns the first effect animation entry whose stored name matches the requested name, or null for null and missing names.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional against a native effect-entry table fixture.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45ff10 validates null-name early return and linear scan over g_zEffectAnim_EntryList using g_zEffectAnim_EntryCount and entry-name string comparison.
The native zEffect smoke verifies null input, missing name, first entry match, and later entry match.
